Package com.sa.gms.restclient.chromadb.clients

Class ChromaTenantClient

java.lang.Object
com.sa.gms.restclient.chromadb.clients.ChromaTenantClient
@Service public class ChromaTenantClient extends Object
Service facade for Chroma DB tenant operations. Provides a clean API for tenant-related operations.
